- Tagline: Juega. Celebra. Disfruta.
- Type: Sports and events venue (fútbol 5 + event space)

## Services

### Field rental (alquiler de cancha)
- Surface: Synthetic grass (césped sintético), fútbol 5 (5v5, max 10 players)
- Capacity: Up to 30 people (players + spectators)
- Day rate: Bs 120/hour
- Night rate: Bs 130/hour (lighting included)
- Booking: via WhatsApp — https://wa.me/59170690685

### Event space (espacio para eventos)
- Includes: Indoor hall (salón), barbecue area (parrilla), equipped kitchen (cocina equipada), synthetic field
- Ideal for: birthdays, corporate events, private celebrations
- Hourly rate: Bs 250/hour (minimum 3 hours)
- Booking: via WhatsApp — https://wa.me/59170690685

## Amenities
- Synthetic grass field with night lighting
